position: We recommend a two-phase architecture: Phase 1 (zero-diff) maps aigate setup tokens and alternative endpoints (Muse/Kimi) into distinct T3 Provider Instances using existing `ProviderInstanceEnvironment` variables and `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` isolation. Phase 2 introduces an upstreamable lightweight `CredentialBroker` interface in `apps/server/src/provider/` that dynamically invokes aigate's `/api/select` and `/api/events/limit` endpoints on session init and retry, bypassing macOS Keychain conflicts by enforcing per-instance sandbox homes. Other providers (Codex, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode) are explicitly excluded from account rotation in v1 as aigate holds no active multi-account rotators for them.

claims.claim: T3 Code already supports per-instance environment variable injection and secret storage without modifying provider core execution logic.
aigate lacks a model enumeration endpoint, so non-Anthropic models (Muse, Kimi) must be declared via T3 model catalog or client-configured pseudo-models.
claims.evidence: aigate codebase inspection: src/providers.js contains key catalogs, but no /api/models endpoint exists in src/server.js

claims.claim: Isolating `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` per T3 provider instance prevents `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` from reading or mutating the system macOS Keychain item `Claude Code-credentials`.
claims.evidence: Drivers/ClaudeHome.ts sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR per instance ID, but SDK behavior regarding macOS Security framework Keychain overrides in headless mode is unverified.
claims.test: Run two T3 Claude instances on macOS with distinct CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR paths and different CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN values; sniff HTTP headers at a local proxy to verify token isolation and inspect Keychain for modification.

claims.claim: Codex, Cursor, Grok, and OpenCode have no multi-account rotation support in aigate v1.
claims.evidence: aigate retirement log (aigate-gpt.sh retired 2026-08-04) and absence of account selection endpoints for non-Claude providers in aigate/src/server.js

challenges.their_claim: aigate should provide model listing for Muse and Kimi K3 to T3 Code
challenges.problem: aigate is strictly a credential vault and Claude account selector; it does not proxy requests or inspect model availability dynamically.
challenges.test: Inspect aigate OpenAPI spec / src/server.js routes; observe absence of GET /api/models.

needs_research: Does @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query() bypass macOS Keychain credential lookup when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN are explicitly defined?
How does Claude Code SDK handle mid-session 429 error callbacks inside T3's event-sourced turn execution loop?
dissent: Cannot mark consensus ready until the macOS Keychain isolation test under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk is verified empirically.

implementation_plan.smallest_shippable_step: Define separate T3 Provider Instances (e.g., 'Claude - Bastardtech', 'Claude - Personal', 'Meta Muse') in ~/.t3/userdata/settings.json, populated with aigate tokens via a local helper CLI, utilizing T3's existing mergeProviderInstanceEnvironment behavior.

provider_decisions.claude: First-class integration via aigate /api/select token broker and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolation.
provider_decisions.codex: Single credential only (out of scope for rotation; GPT rotator retired).

architecture.model_catalog: Extend CLAUDE_MODEL_CATALOG in apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ClaudeProvider.ts with optional custom model definitions for Meta Muse (muse-spark-1.2-contributor) and Kimi K3.
architecture.turn_and_session_hopping: Catch 429/quota errors at ClaudeAdapter.ts query turn boundary, call aigate POST /api/events/limit, re-fetch account from GET /api/select, and re-issue turn with refreshed CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.
